$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the care pack composed with a clinical psychology content seed, re-registered in the inkblot register (a gallery poster: ultramarine ink on an off-white wall) with its own pinned page skeletons. Everything else — pages' builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Psychology Practice
description: A psychology practice's site with real online booking: Dr. Miriam Castellanos, PsyD, and two colleagues in Park Slope and by telehealth, hung like a gallery poster — a huge centered serif "You're not too much." over a symmetrical ultramarine inkblot on an off-white wall, a museum wall label beside it (Anxiety · ADHD · Burnout; First session, Fees & insurance, Is this right for me?), three inkblot plates for the three specialties, fees printed plainly (with superbills and the Good Faith Estimate), ways to pay, the first-session story, three psychologists with portraits, former-client words shared with consent, a plain-spoken FAQ, and a booking page offering a free consultation, a 60-minute first session, and 50-minute sessions. The booking form is clinically empty — name, contact, appointment type, new/returning.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so these practice and appointments seeds replace the base pack's at compose and mirror THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twins) — the composed template's Manage editors and booking widget open on the psychology practice, not the base clinic.

providers.name: Dr. Miriam Castellanos
providers.bio: Miriam treats anxiety in adults who have been told, one way or another, that they're too much. Her work is practical — cognitive behavioral therapy and exposure, explained plainly — and her sessions are, clients report, surprisingly funny. She sees clients in English and Spanish.

providers.name: Dr. Kofi Mensah
providers.bio: Kofi runs the practice's adult ADHD evaluations: an interview, standardized testing, a written report you can actually read, and a long feedback session. He also sees clients for ADHD-focused therapy once the question is answered.

providers.name: Dr. Ingrid Lindqvist
providers.bio: Ingrid spent a decade consulting to hospitals and law firms before returning to therapy. She works with people whose jobs have eaten their sleep, their weekends, and their sense of humor — and helps them get at least two of the three back.

services.name: Anxiety
services.description: Panic, worry that won't switch off, the avoidance that keeps shrinking your week. Cognitive behavioral therapy and exposure, paced with you.

services.name: Adult ADHD evaluation
services.description: A full evaluation across two or three appointments, with testing, a plain-English report, and a feedback session to go through it together.

services.name: ADHD-focused therapy
services.description: After the evaluation: systems, not willpower. Planning, time, the shame that piles up, and how to explain it to the people you live with.

services.name: Burnout
services.description: For the exhausted and overcommitted. We map what's draining you, what you can change, and what you can stop apologizing for.

services.name: Individual therapy
services.description: Grief, transitions, relationships, the thing you can't name yet. Weekly sessions in person or by video.

services.name: Telehealth across New York
services.description: Every service except in-person testing is available by secure video anywhere in New York State.

insurance: Good Faith Estimate for every client

reviews.quote: I'd spent years apologizing for how anxious I was. Dr. Castellanos never once made me feel like a lot. Six months later I took the subway again — and then we planned my last session together.
reviews.name: L. M.

reviews.quote: The report from Dr. Mensah was the first thing about my brain that made sense on paper. I read it twice and then sent it to my mother.
reviews.name: J. K.
reviews.detail: Former evaluation client, shared with consent

reviews.quote: Dr. Lindqvist asked what I used to do for fun. I couldn't answer. Now I can, and I leave work at six.
reviews.name: P. A.

newPatient.title: A free 15-minute consultation
newPatient.body: A short phone call to hear what you're looking for and whether one of us is the right fit. If we're not, we'll suggest who might be.

newPatient.title: Your Good Faith Estimate
newPatient.body: Before your first session you'll receive a written estimate of expected costs, as federal law requires for self-pay clients.

newPatient.title: The first session
newPatient.body: Sixty minutes. We'll talk about what's happening now, what you've tried, and what you'd like to be different. You don't need to prepare anything.

newPatient.title: After that
newPatient.body: Most clients meet weekly at first. Evaluations follow their own schedule: two or three appointments, then a feedback session about two weeks later.

types.name: Free consultation
types.description: A short phone call to see if we're the right fit.

types.name: First session
types.description: The longer first appointment, in person or by video.

types.name: Session
types.description: An ongoing session with your psychologist.

theme.$comment: The inkblot register in its own ultramarine: mode light opens the site in its native appearance (the off-white gallery wall); dark is the gallery after hours. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-inks pages and app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared careShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): care-direct wears the full-width sign band and care-therapy-duet the centered masthead, so the psychology practice takes the split letterhead — wordmark left, catalogue links ruled off right.

landing.$comment: A pinned layout (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): style re-registers the base's pages in the inkblot register, and pages carries exactly the skeletons careLanding.ts emits from this remix's contentSeed — the content-gated sections (exhibits, menu, spotlight, faq) appear because the seed fills them — so the composed template's document reproduces its code config section for section (tests/View/Care/careLanding.test.ts reads this through composedLandingSeed).
